question: Let \(f(x)\) be a real valued function of a variable \(x\) such that \(f'(x)\) takes both positive and negative values and \(f''(x)>0\) for all \(x\). Show that there is a real number \(p\) such that \(f(x)\) is an increasing function of \(x\) for all \(x\ge p\).

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
